note: Vendor (vllm-project/recipes) recipes folded in as *reference*, not as MI250X-validated configs. Each entry separates the hardware-independent flags that transfer to gfx90a from what the vendor's own support matrix gates to MI300X+.

silicon_gated_on_gfx90a: FP8 checkpoint + FP8 GEMM: the entire official AMD lane runs Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 (W8A8, dynamic per-token activations); gfx90a (CDNA2) has no FP8 matrix core, and torch._scaled_mm refuses anything below MI300+ -> engine init dies
--kv-cache-dtype fp8 in the fp8/nvfp4 variant extra_args
transferable_to_mi250x: --language-model-only (skip vision tower): architecture-level, frees HBM per die on a text-only workload where weights alone eat ~48-55 GiB of 64 GiB
VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM=0 + VLLM_DEEP_GEMM_WARMUP=skip (base_env): DeepGEMM is CUDA-only; avoids pointless warmup on ROCm
--reasoning-parser qwen3 (output parsing only; also gates --default-chat-template-kwargs enable_thinking=false)
the num_cache_lines>=batch -> --max-cudagraph-capture-size pitfall: hybrid GDN/Mamba state cache bounds graph capture on every GPU (our boot already logs mamba/attention page-size padding)
MTP is present in the checkpoint (mtp.* tensors) -> --speculative-config mtp is a model-level lever, but the vendor explicitly flags MTP on AMD as under development
--enable-expert-parallel / -dp 8 style MoE parallelism: architecture-level, but xGMI all-to-all cost on MI250X is unmeasured
unverified_on_mi250x: VLLM_SSM_CONV_STATE_LAYOUT=DS (vendor sets it only for pd_cluster prefill+decode)
mi250x_applicability.verdict: vendor recipe is NOT an MI250X-supported configuration; only its hardware-independent parts transfer

troubleshooting.encoder_data_parallel: --mm-encoder-tp-mode data costs extra memory, may need --gpu-memory-utilization tuning
troubleshooting.long_context: YaRN via --hf-overrides nested under text_config (factor 4.0, original_max_position_embeddings 262144) + --max-model-len ~1010000 + VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1

mamba_cache_assert.cause: CUDA-graph capture size > Mamba/SSM state cache size (hybrid GDN+Mamba model)

troubleshooting.mtp_tradeoff: MTP-1 lowers TPOT but costs throughput under concurrency (spec tokens consume KV); num_speculative_tokens 1-5; vendor notes MTP-1 on AMD is still under development

vendor_commands.amd_mi300x_mi355x_tp8: Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 --tensor-parallel-size 8 --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-prefix-caching (docker vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:latest, NO AITER env in the vendor block)

vendor_hardware_matrix.amd_requirement: ROCm wheel needs Python 3.12, ROCm 7.0, glibc >= 2.35
